SELECT p.id, p.first_name, p.last_name, p.company, p.title, p.linkedin_url, p.public_fact, p.profile_score
FROM prospects p
WHERE p.status = 'new'
  AND p.platform = 'linkedin'
  AND p.profile_score >= 6
  AND p.id NOT IN (
    SELECT prospect_id FROM actions
    WHERE action_type IN ('invite_sent', 'invite_failed')
  )
ORDER BY p.profile_score DESC, p.created_at ASC
LIMIT 5;

=INSERT INTO actions (prospect_id, action_type, platform, payload, status, created_at)
VALUES (
  {{ $('prepare-action').item.json.id }},
  'invite_sent',
  'linkedin',
  '{{ JSON.stringify({ message: $('prepare-action').item.json.generatedMessage, response: $json }) }}',
  'success',
  NOW()
);

UPDATE prospects SET status = 'contacted', updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = {{ $('prepare-action').item.json.id }};

=INSERT INTO actions (prospect_id, action_type, platform, payload, status, error_message, created_at)
VALUES (
  {{ $('prepare-action').item.json.id }},
  'invite_failed',
  'linkedin',
  '{}',
  'error',
  '{{ $json.error }}',
  NOW()
);
